summary: Linked list node destructor called from DestroyUIWidgetHierarchy. When the byte flag at this+0xC is non-zero the node's data block is torn down: the primary data pointer at this+0x0 is freed, and its secondary pointer at payload+0x4 is freed first if non-null. The node buffer itself is freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf only when a2 bit 0 is set. Returns this unchanged.

operations.description: Data teardown runs only when the byte flag at this+0xC is non-zero.
Load the primary data block pointer from this+0x0 into v3.
Proceed with the teardown only when the pointer at this+0x0 is non-null.
Free the secondary pointer only when the payload's dword at obj+0x4 is non-null.
Free the secondary data pointer v3[1] via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the primary data block v3 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
The node buffer is freed only when a2 bit 0 is set.
Free the node buffer itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf when a2 bit 0 is set.
Return the node pointer this unchanged.

unresolved: Owner class and the concrete layout of the payload block (primary and secondary pointers) are unknown.
Whether obj+0x4 belongs to the same object as this is not proven; only an equal-offset reading is used.
Semantics of the flag at this+0xC beyond enabling the data teardown are unknown.
